declared difference (row text 2026-10-24): the row names every reset method the rule accepts
(started/atSteadyState/changed/enable/start); the bash lint printed started/atSteadyState/enable.
declared difference (truth fix T2): the bash awk named the method by scanning up to 5 lines above a "{" for
the first lower-case call, so a one-letter or upper-case method name (a(), If()) took the call on the line
above it (the previous body's setAOut / setBOut), a signature wrapped over more than 5 lines was "unknown",
and a nested class's started() took the name of a call above its class line, so its reset did not count
(Nested). Methods now come from javasrc.Methods, the shared method scanner.
